forParishes.title: Publish your Masses, sheets, announcements and activities from a single place
forParishes.intro: Churchy is the platform that helps parishes prepare and share their celebrations, without unnecessary paper.
forParishes.changesTitle: What Churchy changes for your parish

publish.title: Publish your celebrations
publish.text: Build each Mass from templates, add the readings, songs and prayers from your library, then publish in one click. You can also announce the Mass before the sheet is ready.

sheets.title: Share digital sheets
sheets.text: The celebration sheet can be read on a phone, before Mass. The faithful prepare their participation in advance.

news.title: Publish announcements and activities
news.text: Schedules, registrations, collections, pilgrimages, gatherings: everything is published from the same place, on your parish's public page.

paper.title: Cut down on printing
paper.text: Fewer sheets to print and fold every week: time saved for the team and paper saved for the parish.

central.title: Centralise communication
central.text: One single address to give the faithful to find the Masses, announcements and activities of the parish.

team.title: Work as a team
team.text: Invite your collaborators with suitable roles: administrator, preparer, reader.

forParishes.readyTitle: Ready to publish your first Mass?

about.title: About Churchy
about.intro: Churchy brings parishes and their faithful closer together through digital tools.
about.whyText: Preparing a Mass takes time, and parish information is often scattered: printed sheets, notice boards, messages. Churchy brings it all together in one place, easy for the parish to publish and easy for the faithful to read.
about.missionText: To let every parish publish its Masses, celebration sheets, announcements and activities, and every member of the faithful find them before coming.
about.question: A question? <link>Write to us</link>.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.purposeText: These terms govern the use of the Churchy site, which lets parishes publish their celebrations, announcements and activities, and lets visitors read them.
terms.accountsText: An account is required to prepare and publish celebrations. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential.
terms.contentText: Parishes are responsible for the content they publish (texts, images, practical information) and for the rights attached to it.
terms.liabilityText: [To be completed: limitation of liability, service availability, termination.]

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.collectedText: For an account: last name, first name, email address and password (stored in encrypted form). For the contact form: name, email and message.
privacy.useText: This data is used only to provide the service (sign-in, verification and reset emails, replies to your messages).
privacy.cookiesText: Churchy only uses cookies that are needed for your sign-in session and to remember your language. No advertising cookies are used.
privacy.rightsText: You can request access to, correction of or deletion of your data through the Contact page. [To be completed: data controller, retention period.]
